name: Instrument On DataNMesh
description: Instrument Data on DataMesh - Publishing Pipeline

purpose.description: To provide AWM teams with a standardized way to access Instrument Reference Data.
objectives: Publish Instrument Reference Data on DataMesh
Implement an automated pipeline for data publication
Centralize schema for consistent data discovery

value.description: The project aims to eliminate fragmentation in data access across the organization.
benefits: Single standardized source for Instrument Reference Data
Automatic notifications for consumers regarding new data availability
Enhanced data discovery consistency across the enterprise

outcomes.description: Successful implementation of an automated pipeline for Instrument Reference Data.
successCriteria: Availability of centralized schema on federated data catalog
Timely notifications to consumers upon data availability

technologies.name: AWS S3
technologies.description: Storage service for hosting parquet files for the Instrument Reference Data.

technologies.name: AWS Glue
technologies.description: Service to process parquet files and create data partitions based on business requirements.

technologies.name: AWS Lambda
technologies.description: Used to implement partition logic according to lines of business.

technologies.name: Amazon EventBridge
technologies.description: Used to trigger AWS Glue jobs upon arrival of new data in S3.

technologies.name: SNS (Simple Notification Service)
technologies.description: Service to send notifications to consumers when new data partitions are ready.

approach.description: Implementation of an automated publishing pipeline for Instrument Reference Data.

plan.name: Automated Data Publishing Pipeline
plan.description: A pipeline that triggers daily to publish Instrument reference data.

methods.name: Data Ingestion
methods.description: Automated daily ingestion of Instrument data.
steps: Trigger pipeline once daily Start of Day (SOD)
Fetch Instrument, Pricing, and Classification data from various sources

methods.name: Data Processing
methods.description: Processing of parquet files to implement partition logic.
steps: Generate parquet files with Instrument reference data
Trigger AWS Glue jobs for data partitioning

tools.name: AWS S3
tools.description: For storing parquet files of Instrument reference data.

tools.name: Amazon EventBridge
tools.description: For triggering workflows based on events.

tools.name: SNS
tools.description: For notifications related to data availability.

team.name: Asset & Wealth Management Data Team
team.description: Team responsible for implementing the Data Mesh initiative.

roles.name: Lead Software Engineer
roles.description: Technical lead and hands-on engineer for the project.

responsibilities.description: Lead the project implementation and technical decisions.
tasks: Configure AWS services for data processing
